description.value: Lokal Sekondo is the second location of Cafe Lokal, an independent European-inspired coffee shop and café in Kitsilano on Vancouver's busy West 4th Avenue cycling corridor. The menu features a full espresso bar, extensive loose-leaf teas, and a daily selection of in-house baked pastries alongside light meals like avocado toast and breakfast croissants. The café also hosts live music shows and events, giving it a lively community atmosphere beyond a typical coffee stop.
